title: Chapter 1269
text:
Be it the three Universal Civilizations or the World Tree Civilization, they were all empty shells.

Han Xiao exhaled, collected his emotions, and suppressed them in the bottom of his heart. He no longer looked at the blank light sphere in front of him.

"This is not a bad thing. At least the Galaxy is not a phantom of the past like the Celestial Star Alliance. Furthermore, based on the time scale of the Celestial Star Alliance, the Galaxy is still far away from the Great Reboot. I don't even know if I can survive until that day …

By the way, if I search Earth, I wonder if there will be any results. "

Han Xiao suddenly had this idea.

He looked down at the mark and found that the index function did not react this time. He could not help but raise his brows.

"Hmm, no reaction? Then I might be mistaken. My hometown is still another world and has nothing to do with our Iterations …"

Han Xiao shook his head.

He calmed himself down and continued to do his business, entering the information he had read into the storage.

Although the equipment was disconnected, the basic functions were still running. He wanted to use the hardware storage method to see if he could break through the memory capacity limit of the Sanctum.

Very soon, Han Xiao transcribed the technology he had read into the storage. He then began to touch the light sphere again and read the information inside. The new technology replaced some of the information in his mind.

At this time, Han Xiao opened the storage again and found that some information had disappeared at the same time. It seemed to be the same as the parts he had forgotten.

"It seems like this method won't work either. It's a bit like the mechanism of Destiny's Child, but the Sanctum is more advanced … Be it the human brain, mechanical hardware, or anything else, as long as it's a medium that records or transmits information, the form of the medium's existence will be ignored and that part of the information will be eliminated. This is one of the principles of the High Dimensional Information Form …"

Han Xiao muttered to himself. He did not give up and tried different methods a few more times. After confirming that there were no tricks, he could only give up on this idea for the time being.

He put away the storage and stopped meaningless attempts. He looked around the Sanctum space and nodded silently.

The Sanctum Revival was successful, Jayz's words were confirmed, and he had figured out part of the operating mechanism of the Sanctum. His memory capacity had reached the limit. In Han Xiao's opinion, his goal of entering the Sanctum had basically been achieved. He could almost leave through the passage.

Han Xiao was about to leave when he suddenly had a flash of inspiration and realized a problem.

"Wait a minute, I seem to have been influenced by my first impression. I learned about the origin of the Sanctums from Jayz, learned about the contributions of the Savior Civilization and the Sanctum Civilization, and learned about the inheritance from generation to generation, so I know the ins and outs very well … But how did Oathkeeper know so clearly?

If his information only comes from reading the light orbs, then with so many light orbs here and the limited memory capacity, the information he has should be incomplete … "

Han Xiao frowned and became suspicious.

The objects recorded by the Sanctum were not only the final civilization of an Iteration but all civilizations of every Iteration. As long as there were traces of their existence, regardless of whether they were strong or weak, they would be recorded. This was different from individuals.

This meant that only a small number of light balls recorded information about the origin of the Sanctums and the Great Reboot.

According to Han Xiao's experience of reading the many light orbs, if he had not learned the ins and outs of the Sanctum from Jayz, he would not have been able to piece together such clear information just by reading the light orbs on his own. One of the main reasons was the limited memory capacity.

Oathkeeper's authority in the Third Sanctum was far lower than his. If he had not been lucky enough to touch an 'ultimate civilization', it was basically impossible for him to know the ins and outs of the Sanctum clearly. Therefore, Han Xiao was doubtful about the source of Oathkeeper's information. He did not believe that this b * stard was so lucky. Otherwise, why would he need so many years to collect the Sanctum keys?

Han Xiao pondered. Just as he was doubting the existence of the Sanctums, something happened!

Hum!

The Sanctum authority mark on his hand suddenly flickered, blooming with streams of light like threads, weaving into a translucent light screen that floated in front of him.

"Hmm? Another trick? What's this? "

Han Xiao perked up and looked at it.

Strings of characters that he could not understand appeared on the light screen, as if they changed every few paragraphs. Han Xiao could not recognize any of them.

However, the next second, these characters were all translated into the Galaxy language.

"The principle of an Information Form that can automatically translate into a language that the reader can understand …"

Han Xiao calmed himself down and started reading from the beginning. He found that the content about the Sanctums and Iterations was at the very top, clearly explaining the ins and outs of the Sanctums. It was basically the same as what Jayz had said, just with more details.

As he continued reading, there were gaps in the content of every paragraph, and the further down he went, the more gaps there were.

After reading for a while, Han Xiao roughly understood what was going on.

"So that's how it is. This light screen records the messages of the ultimate civilizations of every Iteration. This thing is probably a special message board, passing down the important experiences of the ultimate civilizations from generation to generation.

These messages should be ordered by time. The content at the top is the earliest, the most important basic information about the origin of the Sanctums and Iterations. It's most likely the source of Oathkeeper's information … The further down, the closer it is to the current Iteration, the more random gaps there are. It's probably related to the authority. Only with high authority can there be fewer gaps. "

Han Xiao suddenly understood the meaning of the message board's existence. It was to record the order of the Iterations and let the future generations quickly understand the origin of the Sanctums and the Great Reboot. There was no need to randomly read light balls to piece together the truth. It also allowed the future generations to learn from the experiences of their predecessors and avoid taking the wrong path.

This message board should be the main platform for the ultimate civilizations of the various Iterations to relay information!

Han Xiao was secretly surprised. He pinched his chin and murmured, "I feel that this message board function is not something that comes with the Sanctums but a mutation brought about by the subsequent Iterations …"

Jayz had once said that because of the indestructible characteristic of the Sanctums, many ultimate civilizations used the Sanctums as a breakthrough point and carried out various plans. This caused the Sanctums to mutate again and again with new functions. The Sanctum Revival might have been a mutation because the class of the revival target was not restricted by the Sanctum classification.

This message board was most likely one of the mutated functions. Through the reading earlier, he realized that there were indeed many civilizations' plans that revolved around the Sanctums. The first person who left the message indicated that it was the first to discover the message board function, and there were light balls from earlier Iterations before it.

The first person who left the message also briefly introduced the basic mechanism and various functions of the Sanctums, such as the requirements for the keys of the other Sanctums. Furthermore, as Han Xiao expected, the Sanctum fragments were the authority.

Even the occasional revelation about the Sanctums that Beyond Grade A Supers received was also a mutated new function. It was to allow the people of the Iteration to come into contact with the Sanctums earlier and have more time to develop.

At the same time, the ultimate civilizations of the subsequent Iterations continued the work of explaining the new functions of the Sanctums on the message board. However, most of the content was empty and could not be seen.

"The overlords of every Iteration are paving the way for the future generations …"

Han Xiao's eyes changed, and he glanced at the light screen again with different emotions. Messages came into view one after another.

"Tomorrow is the day to implement the Nirvana Plan. I hope everything goes well."

"Can the Nirvana Plan really succeed? Actually, we're not confident …"

"The principle of the Nirvana Plan is Nirvana. According to our calculations, our success rate is about 1.44%. Maybe our research is not deep enough to survive the Great Reboot, but the technology of the Nirvana Plan will be recorded by the Sanctums. I hope that the future generations can continue to research on our foundation. Our civilization's name is Nirvana.

Please search for it. "" We are the Nirvana Civilization. The Great Reboot has already begun. All of this is not a scam. We are taking advantage of the last moment to leave a message. Our plan is about to fail, proving that the Nirvana Plan technology will not work. I hope that the future generations will not follow our path. This is a dead end.

Remember! "On the light screen, there were messages full of hope, messages without confidence, and messages seriously analyzing their own thoughts …

Looking at these messages, Han Xiao seemed to be able to feel the emotions of these civilizations when they left these messages — suppressing their anxiety, despair, and panic, forcing themselves to calm down and leaving behind a concise and comprehensive legacy for the future generations …

"This is the true meaning of the 'Relay Across Iterations' … What a great cause."

At this moment, Han Xiao finally had a deeper understanding of the name of this mission. He felt complicated and respectful.

"Maybe one day in the future, the three Universal Civilizations will also leave a message here … Hmm, maybe it's the World Tree?"

Han Xiao sighed softly, calmed himself down, thought about it, and started to look for messages related to the Celestial Star Alliance.

Because the message boards were arranged in chronological order, he could see the order of the Iterations. He wanted to find out the order of the Celestial Star Alliance and see how many Iterations they were separated from the galaxy.

He looked at the messages one by one. Suddenly, on the fifth last message, he saw the relevant information.

Because the time was very close, the messages below were mostly empty. However, he saw the familiar term 'Civilization Reboot Plan', which was the Celestial Star Alliance's plan to survive the Great Reboot.

"The fifth last message, huh? This means that the Celestial Star Alliance is at most four Iterations away from us, or at least one Iteration before us …"

Han Xiao nodded.

Because the same Iteration could leave multiple messages, he did not know who the messages in between were from. It could be from other Iterations, or it could be from the Celestial Star Alliance itself. Originally, he could use language as a standard to judge. The same words were left behind by the same Iteration, so he could clearly distinguish them. However, all the messages on the message boards were translated into the Galaxy Lingua Franca. Han Xiao tried, but he could not convert back to the original version. He did not know whether it was because it did not have this function or because he did not have enough authority.

The last few paragraphs were mostly blank. The only valuable information was the last paragraph in the middle of the last paragraph, which had no head or tail.

"… Transforming Information Form into Reality, this is the correct path …"

Han Xiao scratched his head, not knowing what to say.

"Information Form Transformation … The Intelligent Plague and the Sanctum Revival are probably all based on the same principle. However, this message actually said that this path is the correct one … If it really succeeded, how did you guys die?"

Han Xiao sighed helplessly.

After sighing for a while, he tried to leave a message on the light screen but found that there was no response.

"Hmm, speaking of which, this light screen is filled with messages from civilizations. There are no individuals. I wonder if my authority is not enough to leave a message, or if the messages of individuals are not recorded by the message board?"

Unable to understand this problem, Han Xiao could only put it aside for the time being and close the message board.

The goal of this trip was basically completed. In his opinion, the biggest gain was that he had completely recorded the activation methods of the other Sanctums through his authority that far exceeded Oathkeeper's.

Because of the limited memory capacity of the Information Form, if he wanted to gain more, he would probably have to wait until the next time he entered and 'empty' the information inside step by step.

"I hope I can go to the other Sanctums next time. It's best if it's the First Sanctum. My initial authority there is not low either."

Han Xiao mumbled to himself and returned to the stable Sanctum passage.

Looking at the Sanctum reluctantly, Han Xiao turned back and flew into the passage.

When the light filled his vision again and his consciousness became blurry, there was only one thought left in Han Xiaoxin's mind.

"I stayed in the Sanctum for at most five hours. I don't know how much time has passed in the universe …"
